analyticalQuestion: Can all-parent-shell cancellation pay the positive-creation budget from the available heat volume after shellwise positive parts are taken?

palettePolicy.mode: hard two-root cap: navy and rust plus neutrals

panelC.lowerBoundThreshold: sufficiently large dyadic K; K0 not quantified

supportedClaim: For the R0.71E section 10.1 parent-only broad frame, global cell, and heat height zero, the exact positive-defect identity leaves nonnegative viscous and negative-source terms; one global-smooth 2D3C family gives a full-frame creation lower coefficient proportional to K^-2 while the available heat upper bound is proportional to K^-4.
claimBoundary: The K-dependent curves are algebraic asymptotic comparison bounds, not finite-K trajectories, and K0 is not quantified. The result does not cover the later child refinement, matched spatial cells, denominator or refresh faces, another NSE budget, full face-paid weighted BV, regularity, singularity, originality, or the Millennium problem.
